headline: Saif Ali Khan attack trial begins, nurse says intruder demanded ₹1 crore, recalls actor overpowering him
caption:

headline: Manoj Bajpayee, Neeraj Pandey weren't worried about Ghooskhor Pandat title row affecting Gajab Raat, say they ‘moved away’ quickly | Interview
caption:
Manoj Bajpayee Gajab Raat Ghooskhor Pandat title row 🎬

Neeraj Pandey ki produce ki hui film Gajab Raat pehle Ghooskhor Pandat naam se thi.
